# Phase 10 – Client Dashboard & Reporting Automation

## Objective

Centralize all Neon Vision + Digital Transition Marketing data into dynamic, client-facing dashboards. Automate reporting, insights, and predictive recommendations so clients always see *what’s happening, why it matters, and what to do next* without manual intervention.

---

## 1. Dashboard Architecture

### 1.1 Core Dashboards

**A. Executive Command Dashboard (Client-Facing)**

* Revenue Impact
* ROAS / CPA / CAC
* Lead Volume & Quality Score
* Active Services (Pilot, VSO, GEO, Social, Automation)
* AI Confidence Index (predictive score)

**B. Performance War Room (Internal + Sovereign Clients)**

* Real-time ad performance
* Platform-level breakdown (Meta, Google, YouTube)
* Budget utilization
* AI optimization actions taken

**C. Visibility & Dominance Dashboard**

* GEO visibility (ChatGPT / Gemini presence)
* Voice Search rankings
* Zero-click capture rate
* AI plagiarism alerts
